items.name: Europa Clipper Earth Flyby
items.description: NASA’s Europa Clipper will fly by Earth for a second and final gravity assist on its way to Jupiter.

items.name: SNC-1 Dream Chaser Berthing
items.description: NASA TV will livestream the rendezvous and capture of Sierra Nevada Corporation's Dream Chaser cargo craft to the International Space Station.

items.name: Boeing Starliner-1 Docking
items.description: The Starliner-1 spacecraft will dock autonomously to the International Space Station, carrying four astronauts to the International Space Station.

items.name: Boeing Starliner-1 Landing
items.description: Following its deorbit burn, the Boeing CST-100 Starliner will reenter the Earth's atmosphere and land at the White Sands Missile Range using its parachutes.

items.name: Boeing Starliner-1 Undocking
items.description: The Boeing CST-100 Starliner will undock from the International Space Station and conduct a deorbit burn as part of its first operational mission. Following the deorbit burn the capsule will renter the Earth's atmosphere and land at the 'White Sands Missile Range' using its parachutes.

items.name: SNC-1 Dream Chaser Release & Reentry
items.description: The Sierra Nevada Corporation SNC-1 Dream Chaser will be unberthed from the ISS before re-entering the Earth's atmosphere and landing at Kennedy Space Center.

items.name: SNC-1 Dream Chaser Landing
items.description: The Sierra Nevada Corporation SNC-1 Dream Chaser will land autonomously at the Launch and Landing Facility of Kennedy Space Center.
